data.name: CirclesPeopleCountOne
data.comment: The same fragment at a count of one, where the noun inflects. A circle just created shows this.

data.value: We will send them an email with a link. The link is good for 14 days.

data.name: CircleInviteSent
data.value: If that address can be invited, the invitation is on its way.

data.value: For people who will never sign up. You keep their name here; nothing else is stored.

data.name: CircleTransferConfirm
data.value: Hand this circle to {0}? You stay in it as an admin.

data.name: CircleLeaveConfirm
data.value: Leave this circle? You will need a new invitation to come back.

data.name: CircleLeaveKeeps
data.value: Your account stays, and your own Secret-Santa groups, their members and any completed draws are untouched.
data.comment: FR-021: the confirmation has to say what leaving does NOT take, not only what it ends.

data.name: CircleDeleteLead
data.value: Every open invitation is withdrawn as well, and none of this can be undone.

data.name: CircleDeleteNames
data.comment: FR-022: the confirmation names the circle. {0} is the circle's name as stored — never translated.

data.name: CircleDeleteLosesAccess
data.value: {0} people will lose access to it.

data.name: CircleDeleteLosesAccessOne
data.value: One person will lose access to it.
data.comment: FR-022: the same sentence at a count of one, where noun and verb both inflect. No placeholder — "one" belongs inside the sentence in every language.

data.name: CircleDeleteManagedNamed
data.value: These people without an account are deleted with it:
data.comment: FR-022: every managed member is named. The names follow as data, never substituted into the sentence.

data.name: CircleDeleteKeeps
data.value: Your Secret-Santa groups, their draws and any reveal links you shared are unaffected.
data.comment: FR-022: what deletion does not reach.
